stem: How did the geography of New England affect its economic activities?

options.label: A
options.text: Coastal cities expanded business opportunities for mining metals and minerals.

options.label: B
options.text: Moderate climate allowed for longer growing seasons and a larger export of crops.

options.label: C
options.text: Rich soil promoted the international trade of cash crops such as cotton and tobacco.

options.label: D
options.text: Excellent harbors provided commercial opportunities such as shipbuilding and whaling.
